statement: For each J and potential V as above, there are λ0 > 0 and real functions βc, Zσ, Zϵ on (−λ0, λ0), continuous at zero, such that βc(λ) > 0, βc(0) = β0, Zσ(0) = Zϵ(0) = 1, Zσ(λ)Zϵ(λ) ̸= 0. For every fixed |λ| < λ0, every allowed domain D, every b ∈ {free, +, −}, all integers n, m ≥ 0 with n + m ≥ 1, all pairwise distinct interior points x1, . . . , xn, y1, . . . , ym, and all j1, . . . , jm ∈ {1, 2}, the full-sequence limit is lim a↓0 ⟨ n ∏ i=1 Sa(xi) m ∏ k=1 Ea,jk (yk) ⟩λ,b a,D = Zσ(λ)n Zϵ(λ)m Cb D(x; y). (1.4) 2 The same functions and coupling interval apply to every such choice. At each fixed mesh, the infinite-volume limit along periodic square boxes exists for all local observables. Using that state first, and then taking a ↓ 0, gives (1.4) with D replaced by C. In particular its two-spin limit is a nonzero constant times |x − y|−1/4. If ϕ : D → D′ is a conformal bijection between allowed domains, the limiting correlation in D is its counterpart at the image points in D′, multiplied by n ∏ i=1 |ϕ′ (xi)|1/8 m ∏ k=1 |ϕ′ (yk)|. (1.5) The boundary type is transported unchanged.
